name: grill-me
description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding. Walk down every branch of the decision tree, resolving dependencies between decisions one-by-one.

name: grill-with-docs
description: Domain-aware grilling that checks existing documentation, enforces terminology, cross-references code, and updates CONTEXT.md and ADRs inline during the interview

name: ponytail
description: Forces the laziest solution that actually works. YAGNI, stdlib first, native platform features before dependencies. Active every response — zero over-engineering.

name: ponytail-review
description: Review a diff for over-engineering. Finds what to delete: reinvented stdlib, needless deps, speculative abstractions. One line per finding. Invoke manually: /ponytail-review.
